errors.INVALID_CUE_RANGE: A line has an invalid duration.
errors.INVALID_PROJECT: This project is invalid or has missing references.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_PROJECT_VERSION: This project version is not supported.
errors.FFPROBE_UNAVAILABLE: FFprobe was not found. Check diagnostics.
errors.FFMPEG_UNAVAILABLE: FFmpeg was not found. Check diagnostics.
errors.NO_VIDEO: This file has no video track.
errors.PROJECT_EXISTS: This project folder already exists. Choose another name.
errors.STALE_REVISION: The project has changed. Recalculate before applying synchronization.
errors.BUSY: Wait for the job to finish or cancel it.
errors.PROCESS_FAILED: Media processing failed. Check the logs.
errors.MEDIA_MISSING: Project media is missing. Import it again.
errors.MEDIA_PLAYBACK_FAILED: The player could not load the video. Try preparing a new proxy from Audio.
errors.INVALID_SUBTITLE_TRACK: This subtitle track is missing from the media.
errors.BITMAP_SUBTITLES: This track contains images. OCR conversion is required to produce SRT.
errors.EMPTY_SUBTITLE_TRACK: This track has no subtitles to import.
errors.SUBTITLE_EXTRACTION_FAILED: Subtitle extraction failed. Check the processing logs.
errors.DESKTOP_REQUIRED: This feature is available in the desktop app.
errors.ALIGNMENT_TOO_FEW: Import at least three subtitles in each SRT to estimate synchronization.
errors.ALIGNMENT_AMBIGUOUS: Matches are insufficient or ambiguous. Synchronization cannot be applied. Check the SRTs and use timecodes to correct them manually.
errors.INVALID_SPLIT: Place the playhead inside the line, at least 100 ms from either edge.
errors.NO_NEXT_DIALOGUE: There is no next line to merge.
errors.WAVEFORM_FAILED: Waveform computation failed. Check the processing panel.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: Saving failed. Retry before calculating synchronization.
